name: The Head of the Beast
summary: Following the assassination of the treacherous Lord Gregor Lescovar, this assignment directs you from Elling Trias to Master Mathias Shaw in Old Town. Reporting the death of Lescovar cements your standing with Stormwind's clandestine intelligence network.

sections.title: A Matter Resolved
sections.body: With Lord Lescovar struck down before his conspiracies against the realm could bear fruit, the immediate danger to Stormwind's leadership has been severed. Cheese merchant and veteran operative Elling Trias immediately directs you away from the crime scene and into the shadows of Old Town, cautioning you not to let courtly praise turn your head.

sections.title: Reporting to the Spymaster
sections.body: In the hidden chambers of Old Town, Master Mathias Shaw oversees the kingdom's covert apparatus through SI:7. Receiving word of Lescovar's demise, Shaw recognizes your skill and ruthlessness, warmly praising your efficiency while acknowledging that true power in Stormwind does not always sit openly in the palace throne room.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what do i do in head of the beast
faq.answer: This brief interlude tasks you with traveling from Elling Trias to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind's Old Town to confirm that Lord Gregor Lescovar has been slain.
Mathias Shaw is the Master of SI:7, Stormwind's secretive intelligence agency and assassin guild, operating discreetly out of Old Town.

faq.q: Why does Elling Trias send you to Shaw instead of the palace guard?
faq.answer: Trias operates deep within Stormwind's intelligence apparatus. Because Lescovar was a prominent nobleman engaged in high treason, dealing with the aftermath requires secrecy rather than public scandal among the guard.

faq.q: What threat did Lescovar pose to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Lord Gregor Lescovar was actively plotting with subversive agents against the crown and the safety of the capital, betraying the realm from within the nobility.

faq.q: What happens after reporting Lescovar's death?
aliases: next quest after head of the beast
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw prepares to close the book on the conspiracy, sending you toward the final resolution of the subversive threat looming over Stormwind.

faq.q: Where can Mathias Shaw be found?
faq.answer: Mathias Shaw is located in the command building of SI:7, tucked away within Old Town in the eastern quarters of Stormwind City.

angles.text: Reporting directly to Mathias Shaw serves as a vital rite of passage, confirming your reliability to the leader of Stormwind's foremost shadow organization.
Removing corrupt aristocrats from within Stormwind helps stabilize the realm during King Varian Wrynn's deeply destabilizing absence.
